_comment: Hand-curated from the manuscript. Every relation carries a quote that must appear verbatim in the extracted definition of its `quote_in` technique -- a relation without a locatable source line is not included. Verified by tests/test_authored.py.

relations.label: PEFT is a specialisation within the fine-tuning family
relations.source_quote: Full FT is the maximally expressive parametric realization of TL
relations.source_ref: Appendix C, Knowledge Transfer and Task Specialization

relations.label: PEFT strictly extends Partial FT: same mechanism, plus a modular scope
relations.source_quote: the base model's weights remain strictly frozen throughout training
relations.source_ref: Appendix C, Knowledge Transfer and Task Specialization

relations.label: PEFT's modular scope lets adapter task-vectors be combined algebraically
relations.source_quote: structural bridge to Task Arithmetic and Model Merging, where adapter task-vectors can be algebraically combined
relations.source_ref: Appendix C, Knowledge Transfer and Task Specialization

relations.label: At the LLM tier, CPT achieves distributional alignment instead of classical DA
relations.source_quote: mechanism is superseded—CPT achieves distributional alignment by continued self-supervised training on unlabeled target-domain corpora
relations.source_ref: Appendix C, Knowledge Transfer and Task Specialization

relations.label: Domain-specific PEFT absorbs the distributional-gap goal at the LLM tier
relations.source_quote: absorbs the distributional gap goal of DA when applied to domain-specific corpora
relations.source_ref: Appendix C, Knowledge Transfer and Task Specialization

relations.label: ICL supersedes gradient-based meta-learning for few-shot adaptation at the LLM tier
relations.source_quote: supersession is mechanistically grounded: LLM contain sufficiently rich pre-trained representations

relations.label: Domain-adaptive pre-training subsumes TIL's goals at the LLM tier
relations.source_quote: ceiling is imposed by architectural supersession: at the LLM tier, domain-adaptive pre-training and continual PEFT subsume TIL
relations.source_ref: Appendix C, Temporal Adaptation and Maintenance

relations.label: Continued pre-training and domain-adaptive PEFT subsume DIL's goals at the LLM tier
relations.source_quote: ceiling is imposed by the same supersession mechanism as TIL: at the LLM tier, continued pre-training and domain-adaptive PEFT subsume DIL
relations.source_ref: Appendix C, Temporal Adaptation and Maintenance

relations.label: Colloquial "few-shot" splits here: FSL updates weights, ICL does not
relations.source_quote: underlying model artifact unmodified; this is reassigned to ICL
relations.source_ref: Appendix C, Knowledge Transfer and Task Specialization

relations.label: Task-vector-negation unlearning is mechanistically identical to task arithmetic
relations.source_quote: mechanistically identical to Task Arithmetic executed with a negation operator
relations.source_ref: Appendix C, Knowledge Modification and Activation-Based Adaptation

relations.label: ReFT trains permanent intervention matrices; Activation Steering computes transient vectors
relations.source_quote: distinct from Activation Steering (which calculates transient vectors) because ReFT permanently trains its intervention matrices
relations.source_ref: Appendix C, Knowledge Transfer and Task Specialization
